description: This file defines an Android activity named 'ExpandableList3' that demonstrates the use of expandable list views backed by a simple map-based adapter. It creates sample grouped data with child items, sets up a SimpleExpandableListAdapter, and binds it to the activity's list view.

classes.name: ExpandableList3
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating expandable list views with grouped data

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the expandable list activity, creates sample group and child data, sets up the adapter, and binds it to the list view.
